qualifiedVerdicts.content:
Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate a8e87dd and serialized rechecks of the signed fix commit 07ad251 found no remaining defect. The 40 lane files (30 new cards and the navigation files kanji/厚, words/みっともない, words/ゴール, words/ストップ, words/成長, words/止まる, words/相撲, words/苗代, words/西暦 and words/誕生日) were copied byte-identically from the authoring worktree's local-only scratch commit acc9bcc; no link was held from an earlier batch, and no follow-up edit from an earlier fix was applied at the candidate. Before the candidate the coordinator read all 30 cards in full against frozen EN ("8 cards read directly, the other 22 via an aligned EN/RU paragraph dump, b249-adj-read.txt; paragraph parity with EN for all 30") and compared the non-title metadata mechanically ("all match except the two RU-added exclusions below"). Its link audit found "no lost links; one RU-only link (畳む → [広げる](広げる.md), accepted below)" and recorded "EN targets not yet published stay plain (words 特売 建つ あてはまる 生産地; kanji 畳 略 訳 植 応 請)". That list mixes three kinds of item: the three absent EN word link targets 特売 (from 発売), 建つ (from 発つ) and あてはまる (from あてはめる); 生産地, which EN 産地:29 mentions only in plain text and RU names in prose; and the six written kanji without an RU kanji card (EN links 畳, 略, 訳 and 植 among them; EN has no card for 応 or 請). A mechanical count of `.md` link targets in EN finds 7 EN link occurrences to 7 absent RU targets. The coordinator edited sixteen lane cards: titles and H1s of 番地 («номер участка или дома (в адресе); адрес»; "the draft narrowed EN "address" to computer memory"), 公務 («официальные обязанности; государственные дела»), 役目 («обязанность; роль; предназначение»; "the title dropped EN "duty""), あてはめる («применять (правило к случаю); подставлять (в формулу); вписывать (в категорию)»), 住まい («жилище; место, где живут»; "«кров» is bookish"), 発売 («выход в продажу»), スタート («старт; отправная точка»), 畳む («складывать (бельё, зонт, футон); закрывать своё дело») and 申し訳ない («простите; непростительно»; "register: «мне нет оправдания» is too heavy for routine お待たせして申し訳ありません"), and examples or prose in 公務, 役目, 畳む, 申し訳ない, 用途, 応用, 原産, 生長, 厚かましい («Простите за наглую просьбу, но…»), 生意気 and 生存, mostly for "natural Russian". It accepted as drafted 略す 発つ 住居 留守番 留まる 申請 田植え 実用 当番 用語 産地 ずうずうしい 生年月日 人命 (plus the edited cards' unchanged prose); kept 略す's title ("«опускать» would collide with unguarded 下げる/下ろす/降ろす and «сокращать» with 減らす"); rejected the 申し訳ない alternatives «приношу извинения» / «прошу прощения» as "near-duplicates of unguarded 詫びる"; accepted the RU-only link 畳む → 広げる ("a substantive antonym comparison; target already in RU"), the two RU-added exclusions below and the adapted English-dependent EN notes (人命 singular/plural "life", "now about Russian number"; 応用 and あてはめる English "apply" polysemy, "now a direct 塗る / 申し込む contrast"); and it left the navigation gloss «наглый; бесстыдный» in kanji/厚 unchanged although the card title is «наглый; беззастенчивый». Fix 1 later rewrote the adapted 応用:33 and あてはめる:33 contrast (comprehensibility C1 and C2); the coordinator's other edits stand. Fix 1 also changed 略す, 発つ, 留まる, 申請, 田植え and 実用, which the coordinator had accepted as drafted, and passages the coordinator had left unchanged in 申し訳ない, 役目, 原産 and 住まい. Lane validation: "manifest 5,589 files (version 88d083ee4368de1b); validate 0 errors; 124 tests OK; budget OK (5,606 entries; localZipBytes 8,101,858); link parity: only the accepted RU-only 畳む→広げる link (40 files); navonly 10 files / 10 links; diff --check clean; paragraph parity with EN for all 30." The lane manifest version differs from the candidate's because the lane tree also carries its own copies of earlier lane drafts. The candidate script checked that the lane was clean at acc9bcc with parent 2d85e8d, that HEAD was the Batch 248 publication record with the published baseline as its parent and as origin/main, that the ten navigation files were unchanged between 2d85e8d and the published HEAD and that no new word file already existed; it copied the 40 lane files, byte-compared every copy with the lane, regenerated the manifest (5,589 entries: 5,584 files, 3 images and 2 scenes; contentVersion ff40e930d163cbc9) and checked that the changed path set was exactly the 40 batch paths plus manifest.json; its stopping checks (validate, unit tests, budget, `git diff --check`, the navigation-only check over the ten files and the tracking-ledger pre-check) passed. For this record the 40 committed content blobs at a8e87dd and at 07ad251 were checked: none has a BOM or CR, and every file ends with a newline; link parity at a8e87dd ("checked 40") shows no LOST link and one EXTRA, the reviewed RU-only 畳む → 広げる link, and at 07ad251 ("checked 40") the same EXTRA and four LOST links removed by design in fix 1 (応用→申し込む, あてはめる→申し込む, 申請→適用 and 役目→行事). The candidate title screen (b249-cand-screen.txt, 588 lines: 65 OK and 523 !! lines) has 15 exact-segment lines. Eleven are OK, each guarded by the batch card's own EN entry: スタート–始め «старт», 畳む–折る «складывать», 住まい–宅 and 住まい–家 «жилище», 番地–住所 «адрес», 申し訳ない–お待ちどおさま and 申し訳ない–すみません «простите», and 役目–務め, 役目–役, 役目–役割 and 役目–義務 («обязанность»/«роль»). Four are !!: 住まい–場, 住まい–場所, 住まい–所 and 住まい–陰 «место», declined in the author report («место» is qualified by «где живут», and the leading «жилище» separates the whole titles) and not raised by any blind reviewer. b249-screen.txt (588 lines) differs from the candidate screen in ten stem-only lines on each side: they show the published titles of おやすみ, 書留, 先頭, 純粋 and 直前 instead of the lane's pre-publication copies; no exact-segment line differs. b249-title-screen.txt, b249-title-screen2.txt and b249-title-screen3.txt are earlier screens with 住まい's pre-adjudication title «кров; место, где живут»; their only exact-segment lines are the four 住まい «место» lines. Correctness raised no finding (correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN for all 30 cards) and proposed no optional note. Consistency raised two quiz-safety findings (consistency, links, metadata, manifest, intake CLEAN; quiz safety NEEDS FIX; both "low-to-medium severity, moderate confidence"): Q1, 略す against 減らす «уменьшать; сокращать», and Q2, 申し訳ない against 詫びる «приносить извинения; просить прощения»; fix 1 appended 減らす and 詫びる to the two lists. Its optional notes covered the RU-only 畳む → 広げる link ("an acceptable substantive antonym link"), the wording of 止まる:53 around 留まる, five weak overlaps (役目–用, 番地–番, 発売–刊行/発行, 留守番–預かる/預ける, 生長–増加), 厚かましい's missing exclusion key and stem-only in-batch pairs. Comprehensibility raised twelve findings (comprehensibility NEEDS FIX; scoped coverage NEEDS FIX for 発つ only, the other 29 CLEAN): six medium (C1, C2, C3, C4, C6, C8) and six low (C5, C7, C9, C10, C11, C12). C1–C5: English-dependent contrasts. 応用:33 and あてはめる:33 now read «По-русски можно сказать и «применять мазь», но нанесение мази или краски — это [塗る](塗る.md)（ぬる）, а не 応用.» (あてはめる keeps its rule-appropriateness sentence); the 申し込む contrasts and links are gone. The 申請:33 sentence «Это не «применение» правила или метода, как в [適用](適用.md)（てきよう）.» and the 役目:41 sentence «役目 — это роль или назначение, а не мероприятие: мероприятие называет [行事](行事.md)（ぎょうじ）.» are deleted. 申し訳ない:33 drops the sadness/condolence sentence and reads «申し訳ない выражает извинение или извиняющийся ответ на доставленное беспокойство.» C6: 発つ's title, H1 and line 16 are now «уезжать; отправляться в путь» instead of «уезжать; отбывать». C7: 発つ:33 now reads «…и 建つ（たつ）— о том, что строение возводится.» C8: 実用:29 now reads «…практическую пользу или пригодность…», avoiding 応用's title «практическое применение». C9: 原産:33 now reads «Речь об исходном происхождении, а не о месте, где растение или животное находится сейчас.» C10 (役目:27 collection framing) was declined. C11: 留まる:19 reads «Ущерб ограничился небольшими масштабами.» C12: 住まい:18 reads «Я ищу новое жильё.» Its optional note on 田植え:33 was adopted: «В примерах это существительное употребляется с 手伝う и 始まる; не стройте отсюда урок спряжения с する.» All accepted changes are in the one signed fix commit 07ad251 ("Batch 249 fix 1: apply blind-review dispositions"). B249 had one signed fix commit after the blind reviews: fix 1 (07ad251) applied the dispositions of all three reviews (12 word cards — 略す, 申し訳ない, 応用, あてはめる, 申請, 役目, 発つ, 実用, 原産, 留まる, 住まい, 田植え — + manifest.json; no navigation-only file changed, so navigation stays at 10 files / 10 links). Each reviewer rechecked the fix diff a8e87dd..07ad251 once, serially (comprehensibility, then correctness, then consistency; the initial reviews ran correctness, then consistency, then comprehensibility), read-only, with no generator run; the rechecks were written as separate reports (b249-recheck-{correctness,consistency,comprehensibility}.md), and the three recheck briefs are saved as b249-recheck-msg-{comprehensibility,correctness,consistency}.txt.
Comprehensibility (grok-4.7) at 07ad251 reported "Verdicts: comprehensibility CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN" and "Findings: none". It reconciled C1 (応用:33, the 塗る contrast «По-русски можно сказать и «применять мазь», но нанесение мази или краски — это 塗る…»), C2 (あてはめる:33, the same contrast; dropping 申し込む "by design"), C3 (申請, the 適用 sentence deleted), C4 (役目, «не мероприятие» deleted), C5 (申し訳ない:33), C6 (発つ title, H1 and line 16 «уезжать; отправляться в путь»), C7 (発つ 建つ（たつ）; scoped coverage for 発つ now CLEAN), C8 (実用 «практическую пользу или пригодность»), C9 (原産), C11 (留まる:19 «Ущерб ограничился небольшими масштабами.») and C12 (住まい:18 «Я ищу новое жильё.») as resolved, and withdrew C10 (decline accepted, with the qualification that the quiz hint shows the English slug `mixed-reading`, so "learner-visible" is only partial). Optional 田植え resolved; the declined optionals (畳む «футон», 生長 «произрастание», あてはめる title length, 住居 «жилое помещение») "optional; decline accepted. They were not defects." It checked the new text on 応用:33, あてはめる:33, 申し訳ない:33 and 発つ and found no regression. Its stated limits: dictionaries not re-opened; validate.py not re-run; B250–B258 lane copies are not this HEAD; no claim about quiz runtime beyond the hint source read.
Correctness (gpt-6.1-sol) at 07ad251 reported "Verdicts: Correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN on HEAD in this recheck scope. No regression established; unchanged batch cards retain the prior review." and "Findings: None". It had no original findings or optional recommendations to reconcile; its reconciliation lines classify its original limits (two new guards checked, "partially resolved" because no full-corpus synonym/runtime quiz audit; "four intentional removals are acceptable"). It read all 12 changed cards in full against frozen EN and checked each changed passage, citing JMdict and Digital Daijisen (via weblio.jp) for 申し訳ない, 塗る, 応用, あてはめる, 発つ, 建つ and 実用; it judged the 減らす and 詫びる guards defensible and the four removed links (応用/あてはめる→申し込む, 申請→適用, 役目→行事) English-dependent, with their exclusions retained. All 24 Japanese examples and kana readings unchanged; manifest changes only contentVersion and the 12 matching hashes; read-only validate.py 0 errors. Its stated limits: post-fix recheck, not another blind review or endorsement of all coordinator rationales; other reviewers' reports not read; no generator or repository write; CLEAN is a bounded absence of established defects, not exhaustive correctness.
Consistency (claude-sonnet-5.5) at 07ad251 reported "Verdicts: consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN (HEAD)" and "Findings: none". It reconciled Q1 (略す→減らす) and Q2 (申し訳ない→詫びる) as resolved, the optional 止まる:53 wording and the weak overlaps (役目–用, 番地–番, 発売–刊行/発行, 留守番–預かる/預ける, 生長–増加) as optional with the decline accepted, and 畳む→広げる, 住まい→住居 and 用途→応用 as acceptable. It found no exact-segment collision for the new 発つ title (the «отправ-» hits with 送る, 速達 and 書留 are stem-only; 発つ's EN exclusions unchanged), confirmed that the four removed links keep their EN exclusions and leave no dangling or asymmetric link, that the manifest diff changes exactly contentVersion and 12 hashes, and that the post-fix screen paragraph matches its observation. Its stated limits: manifest hashes verified by diff inspection only (no generator run); its title screen used its earlier pre-fix title list plus direct reads of the changed cards; no dictionary access beyond what the cards cite.
The coordinator took no further action: no reviewer reported a new finding or an open optional note. No actionable finding remains; no second fix is needed. Fix 1 changed no Japanese example sentence, sourced reading, kanji card, navigation file or EN exclusion; it changed twelve new word files (15 lines added and 17 removed) and the manifest. It retitled 発つ, added two exclusions (略す–減らす and 申し訳ない–詫びる) and removed four links to existing cards together with the English-dependent sentences that carried them (応用→申し込む, あてはめる→申し込む, 申請→適用 and 役目→行事); the EN exclusions on those pairs remain. No file at 07ad251 contains the old 発つ wording «отбывать». All three reviewers read all 30 new cards in full. The correctness and comprehensibility reviewers compared each with its full EN original; the consistency reviewer verified the cards against EN programmatically ("front matter, link sets, heading counts, footer entries and sense numbers"). All three read the ten navigation diffs; the consistency reviewer also checked the intake paths and hashes, recomputed the manifest in memory ("An in-memory manifest recompute equals the committed `manifest.json`"; this created a Python bytecode cache under `tools`, which it deleted) and ran `tools/validate.py` (0 errors) at the candidate; the correctness reviewer ran the validator read-only at the candidate (0 errors); the comprehensibility reviewer records no validator run. At recheck the correctness and consistency reviewers ran the validator read-only (0 errors each). All three initial reports and all three recheck reports record a clean status. No reviewer wrote generator output. Evidence includes the Jisho/JMdict API, Digital Daijisen via Weblio, kanjiapi.dev, gramota.ru, the pinned docs/n2-vocabulary-sources.tsv and, for the C10 decline, kanji-cards-android WordQuizScreen.kt. Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, recheck reports, reconciliation and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 222 EN exclusions across 29 lists are retained in EN order (EN has no list on 厚かましい). 15 lie inside the batch: 発つ–スタート, 番地–住居 and 住まい, 応用–あてはめる, 申請–応用, 実用–応用, 役目–当番 and 公務, 用途–実用 and 役目, 産地–原産, ずうずうしい–厚かましい, 生意気–ずうずうしい and 厚かましい, and 生存–人命; the other 207 target existing RU cards. Four direct, one-sided exclusions on four new cards cover reviewed RU title overlaps, each appended at the end of its list. Two were present at the candidate: 住まい–住居 (住居 «жилое помещение; место проживания») and 用途–応用 (応用 «практическое применение (знаний, теории)»). The coordinator accepted them as "住まい→住居 (required: «место, где живут» vs «место проживания»), 用途→応用 (conservative: shared «применение»)"; the consistency reviewer classed 住まい→住居 as "required" ("The titles «жилище; место, где живут» and «жилое помещение; место проживания» are near synonyms.") and 用途→応用 as "conservative but acceptable", so the two records agree; the correctness reviewer found "Both are defensible direct overlap protections." Fix 1 added two: 略す–減らす (減らす «уменьшать; сокращать»; consistency Q1: "can share "сокращать" with 減らす … EN already guards 縮める, which has the same overlap") and 申し訳ない–詫びる (詫びる «приносить извинения; просить прощения»; Q2: "詫びる already lists 申し訳, but the contract is symmetric and applies to direct pairs, so the pair must be declared on at least one side. The same relation is already guarded for 謝る."). The candidate title screen (b249-cand-screen.txt; 588 lines) has 65 OK lines for guarded pairs and 523 !! lines; of its 15 exact-segment lines, eleven are guarded by the batch card's own EN entries (スタート–始め, 畳む–折る, 住まい–宅 and 家, 番地–住所, 申し訳ない–お待ちどおさま and すみません, 役目–務め, 役, 役割 and 義務), and four, 住まい–場, 場所, 所 and 陰 «место», are unguarded and were declined in the author report. A saved rerun at 07ad251 over the 30 batch words (b249-fix-screen.txt; 597 lines) has 71 OK lines and 526 !! lines and the same 15 exact-segment lines; the only unguarded ones are still the four 住まい «место» lines. Against the candidate screen it removes 3 lines and adds 12, from the 発つ retitle and the two new guards: 発つ 1 removed and 9 added (発つ–送別 changes wording; the new «отправ-» stem adds 発つ–出かける, 出発 and 発車, all OK, and 発つ–書留, 船便, 送る, 速達 and 郵送, all stem-only !! lines), スタート 0 and 1 (スタート–発つ, OK), and 略す–減らす and 申し訳ない–詫びる 1 and 1 each (stem-only !! to OK). The consistency recheck found "No exact-segment collision among RU titles" for the new 発つ title and judged the «отправ-» mail hits stem-only. Every RU addition is appended at the end of its list, and no EN entry is removed or reordered. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.

scope.navigationNote: Restored 10 relative links in the 10 listed Markdown files at the corresponding EN-linked positions, using EN's href form (../words/X.md in kanji files, X.md in word files): kanji 厚 to 厚かましい (line 37, a word-list line, matching EN line 37); word みっともない to 厚かましい (line 36, matching EN line 29); word ゴール to スタート (line 33, matching EN line 28); word ストップ to スタート (line 29, matching EN line 35); word 成長 to 生長 (line 42, matching EN line 42); word 止まる to 留まる (line 53, matching EN line 41); word 相撲 to 住まい (line 32, matching EN line 41); word 苗代 to 田植え (line 38, matching EN line 32); word 西暦 to 生年月日 (line 34, matching EN line 34); and word 誕生日 to 生年月日 (line 28, matching EN line 28). Each file changes exactly one line. Six files mention their target only on the linked line; 成長 (lines 44 and 57), 止まる (lines 47, 52, 58 and 65), 苗代 (line 19) and 西暦 (line 19) also name it in plain text elsewhere, as EN does. All ten files were copied from the authoring worktree; no link was held from an earlier batch, no surrounding prose changed at the candidate, and no navigation file changed after the candidate. The existing gloss «наглый; бесстыдный» in kanji/厚 was left unchanged although the 厚かましい card title is «наглый; беззастенчивый». Unavailable word targets remain plain text; no substitute cards were invented.
scope.selection: Batch 88 selected 30 word cards from the frozen source: chunk 41 of the 72-batch dependency-closed queue of the general remaining-word pool (computed after Batch 207 from 2,157 remaining EN words; 927 remained after Batch 248, and 897 remain after this batch). Its closure under the source quiz-exclusion edges is exactly the 30 requested words; nothing outside them was added. Fifteen source exclusion entries lie inside the batch; the other 207 EN exclusion entries target existing RU cards.
scope.unwrappedAbsentTargetsNote: Absent RU targets remain unwrapped (7 EN link occurrences, 7 targets) in the new cards: 発売→words/特売, 発つ→words/建つ, あてはめる→words/あてはまる, 畳む→kanji 畳, 略す→kanji 略, 申し訳ない→kanji 訳 and 田植え→kanji 植. 6 written kanji have no RU kanji card: 応 植 略 畳 訳 請 (EN has cards only for 植, 略, 畳 and 訳). Four EN links to existing cards were deliberately removed by fix 1 together with their English-dependent sentences, so link parity reports them as LOST: 応用→words/申し込む and あてはめる→words/申し込む (EN's English "apply/application" contrasts; RU keeps the 塗る contrast in Russian terms), 申請→words/適用 (EN's English "application" note) and 役目→words/行事 (EN's English "function" note); the EN exclusions on those pairs are retained. Links otherwise follow EN, with one reviewed RU-only link to an existing card at a substantive comparison where EN has plain text, present at the candidate: 畳む:29 → words/広げる («[広げる](広げる.md)（ひろげる）— «раскладывать, разворачивать» — противопоставляется складыванию в компактную форму.»; EN 畳む:40-41 has the plain text "広げる (ひろげる), \"spread out,\" contrasts with folding something compact."). All 8 EN links between batch cards are kept.

titleDecisions.declinedOptional: Declined, modified or no-action items: correctness raised no finding and no optional note. Consistency Q1 and Q2 were accepted with the reviewer's remedies. Its optional 止まる:53 wording was declined: "止まる is a navigation-only restoration file; only link positions are wrapped and the wording is not changed in this batch. The sentence keeps EN's meaning (EN 止まる:41)." Its weak overlaps (役目–用, 番地–番, 発売–刊行/発行, 留守番–預かる/預ける, 生長–増加) were declined ("reviewer: not required; no shared exact title segment or near-synonym answer"), and 畳む → 広げる, 住まい→住居 and 用途→応用 were judged acceptable with no change. Comprehensibility C3, C4, C5, C6, C7 and C9 were accepted. C1 and C2 were accepted with modification: the reviewer's «прикладной» replacement for 応用:33 was not used because "line 21 already explains 応用物理学 «прикладная физика» without な", and in both cards the 塗る contrast is kept in Russian terms because "Russian does say «применять мазь»"; the 申し込む links are LOST by design and the exclusions stay. C8 was accepted with modification («практическую пользу или пригодность» instead of the proposed «пригодность в реальном деле»; "This avoids 応用's quiz title «практическое применение» while keeping EN's "utility" point."). C11 and C12 were accepted with modification: «Ущерб ограничился небольшими масштабами.» ("the reviewer's «за рамки небольшого» is elliptical") and «Я ищу новое жильё.» ("the reviewer's «жилище» is bookish"). C10 was declined: "The classification is learner-visible: the word quiz hint shows non-origin tags such as `mixed-reading` (kanji-cards-android `WordQuizScreen.kt:150`), and published RU 話し中:27 uses the same collection framing.
